{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.mjs\",\"content\":\"export function allocateShares(totalCents, people) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(totalCents) || totalCents <= 0) throw new Error('Bill total must be greater than $0.');\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(people) || people < 1 || people > 1000) throw new Error('Number of people must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000.');\\n\\n  const each = Math.floor(totalCents / people);\\n  const remainder = totalCents % people;\\n  return Array.from({ length: people }, (_, index) => each + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));\\n}\\n\"}","text":null}
